title: Accessory Price List and Labor-Warranty Upgrades for Replacement System Installations
content:
# Accessories and labor-warranty upgrades — Replacement System Installations

## Accessory price list

Accessories not included in the package may be added to a Replacement System Installations contract at the prices below, as one accessory charge per accessory.

| Accessory | Price |
|---|---|
| Smart thermostat upgrade | $389.00 |
| Whole-home surge protector | $295.00 |
| UV germicidal light | $849.00 |
| Media air cleaner | $1195.00 |
| Steam humidifier | $2450.00 |
| Condensate pump | $289.00 |

**Clauses in force on accessories.**

- An accessory the package already includes is never billed.
- The smart thermostat upgrade is offered only on a package to which the smart thermostat upgrade can be added.
- Each accessory added is one accessory charge for that accessory.

**Retired clause.** The following clause, which tied a member discount to each accessory at the Comfort Club tier's accessory discount percentage, is **no longer in force** and has been superseded by the current basis for member discounts on accessories:

> A Comfort Club member whose agreement is active on the date the accessory is added receives the tier's accessory discount percentage on that accessory, posted as an accessory member discount naming the accessory charge and rounded to the cent half up.

## Protection with the installation

- The protection tier the package includes is issued at completion at no charge.
- A higher protection tier from the package's list of upgrade tiers may be added before installation as one labor-warranty upgrade charge, priced at the Harbison Protection Contracts installation price for that tier, scope and capacity.
- Only one upgrade tier may be bought per project.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical contracts)

- A hypothetical Harbison Signature Series System contract already includes a UV germicidal light, so no UV germicidal light accessory charge is billed on it; a media air cleaner added to the same contract is one accessory charge of $1195.00.
- A hypothetical Harbison Performance Series System contract cannot take the smart thermostat upgrade, because that package does not offer it.
- A hypothetical homeowner who has added one upgrade tier to a project cannot buy a second upgrade tier on the same project.
